name: kollate
description: Capture your Claude Code conversations into your organisation's Kollate workspace

endpoint.title: Kollate URL
endpoint.description: Your organisation's Kollate address. Leave empty for the hosted https://app.kollate.ai; set it only if your organisation runs Kollate at its own address.

capture_token.title: Setup key (machines with no browser only)
capture_token.description: Only for SSH sessions, containers and remote machines. Everywhere else run /kollate:connect instead, which needs no copying. Get this from Connect in Kollate: 'Set up a machine without a browser'.
